notif.title: Notifications
notif.description: Everything Ledger told you, newest first. Deadlines coming up are pinned on top.
notif.empty: Nothing yet. When Ledger reads a letter or finishes a payment, it shows up here.
home.firstTime: Take a photo of any government letter with the button below, or ask Ledger anything. Your deadlines will show up on the calendar.
cal.pitch: See your own events here too.
cal.connectError: Google Calendar didn't connect. Please try again.

cal.scopeMissing: Almost: on Google's screen, tick the box to let Ledger see your calendars, then connect again.
mail.pitchTitle: Let Ledger watch your Gmail for letters from agencies.
mail.pitch1: Spam, promotions and social mail are skipped.
mail.pitch2: Emails from government agencies go to the top; fake ones are flagged.
mail.pitch3: An attached notice is read by Ledger automatically.
